cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: A Pokémon with a loyal nature, it will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.description: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.description: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.description: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.description: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.description: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

cards.name: Basculin
cards.description: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.description: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.description: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.description: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.description: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.description: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.description: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.description: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.description: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

cards.name: Muk
cards.description: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.description: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

cards.name: Munna
cards.description: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.description: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.description: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.description: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.description: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.description: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.description: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.description: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.description: They has mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.description: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.description: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.description: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: It immediately headbutts anyones that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.description: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.description: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.description: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.description: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.description: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.description: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
